brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Liberman has proposed that Jordan assume administrative control of the West Bank, Ma'an reported. The proposal represents a significant shift in Israeli policy discussion regarding Palestinian governance structures in the occupied territory.

Details of the proposal's scope, timeline, and response from Jordanian authorities were not immediately available. The suggestion comes amid ongoing disputes over Palestinian self-governance arrangements.
title: Liberman proposes handing West Bank administration to Jordan
